OBJECTIVES: We aimed to characterize endodermal transcriptional programs associated with early shoot gravitropism and determine how loss of functional SGR5 alters gravity-associated transcriptional-state organization. METHODS: We generated a time-resolved single-nucleus RNA-sequencing (snRNA-seq) atlas of Arabidopsis inflorescence stems at 0, 20, 40, and 60 min after gravistimulation in wild-type Col-0 and the gravitropism-defective sgr5 mutant. These data were integrated with gene regulatory network (GRN) inference, publicly available SGR5 DNA affinity purification sequencing (DAP-seq) profiles, and transient dual-luciferase reporter assays for selected promoters. RESULTS: We propose a two-component working model of SGR5-associated transcriptional regulation. The first component comprises DAP-seq-supported, genotype-associated candidate genes, including LAZY1, SGR9, and WDL7, linked to gravity signaling, amyloplast-actin dynamics, auxin-related regulation, and cytoskeletal organization. The second component comprises a distinct growth- and cell wall-associated GRN state marked by three-amino-acid-loop-extension (TALE) homeobox candidate hubs KNOTTED-like from Arabidopsis thaliana 1 (KNAT1), BEL1-like homeodomain 1 (BLH1), and BEL1-like homeodomain 2 (BLH2), together with the basic helix-loop-helix (bHLH) factor CRY2-interacting bHLH 2 (CIB2). In sgr5, these programs showed reduced coordination, with reduced representation of gravity- and growth-associated states and increased representation of stress- and metabolism-associated states. Transient dual-luciferase assays showed that SGR5 enhanced WDL7, LAZY1, and SGR9 promoter-reporter activity, supporting SGR5-associated promoter regulation. CONCLUSION: Our findings support an endodermis-resolved working model in which loss of functional SGR5 is associated with altered gravitropism-related candidate-gene expression and organization of a distinct growth- and cell wall-associated GRN state, with transient reporter assays providing functional support for SGR5-dependent regulation of selected promoters.

summary.takeaway: 通过时间分辨单核RNA测序图谱，揭示拟南芥茎向重力性中内皮层基因调控网络，提出SGR5相关的双组分工作模型，并显示sgr5突变体相关转录程序协调性降低。
summary.methods: 对野生型Col-0和sgr5突变体花序茎在重力刺激后0、20、40、60分钟进行单核RNA测序，整合基因调控网络推断、公开SGR5 DAP-seq数据和瞬时双荧光素酶报告实验。
summary.relevance: 与GRN/Regulon主题直接相关，研究特定转录因子SGR5相关的基因调控网络及其在向重力性中的作用。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供全基因组范围的统计显著性结果；工作模型基于候选基因和报告实验，需进一步功能验证。

papers.title: Typed Knowledge over Constructive Institutions: A Proof-Relevant Type Theory for Verified Science
papers.abstract: Mathematical proof assistants such as Coq, Agda, and Lean 4 build proof irrelevance into definitional conversion ($p \equiv q$ for $p, q : P$ with $P : Prop$), erasing which derivation established a theorem. While natural for mathematics over fixed axioms, judgmental proof irrelevance is incompatible with verified scientific stores, which must inspect and compare independent derivations of the same claim to assess consilience and compute counterfactual retractions when an assay, reagent, or model is invalidated. Moreover, combining definitional proof irrelevance with subsingleton elimination breaks strong normalization and renders algorithmic conversion non-transitive. We present the type-theoretic and institutional foundations of Eigenius, a verified knowledge substrate for science. First, we formulate a dependent kernel with cumulative universes ($Prop, Set, Type_k$), impredicative $Prop$, inductive families with index-forced subsingleton elimination, and intensional identity types, where definitional equality $\equiv$ is untyped joinability under an orthogonal CRS and proof irrelevance is a witnessed propositional axiom ($irrel : ΠP{:}Prop.\,Πp,q{:}P.\,Id\,P\,p\,q$). Second, we unify universe cumulativity, codomain-covariant $Π$-subtyping, and ontology class inclusions in a coercion-free subsumption judgment whose bidirectional fragments ($\mathcal{K}_0, \mathcal{K}_1$) satisfy subject reduction and are sound and complete for declarative typing. Third, we organize external verifiers into a three-level institutional hierarchy with explicit axiom policies (Adopt, Discharge, Relativize), internalize a justification logic with Why-provenance semiring support $supp(j,P)$, and embed Cooper's Type Theory with Records (TTR) to type open-world knowledge graphs. Finally, we prove consistency in Grothendieck universes and mechanize the metatheory in Lean 4 with zero sorry axioms.

summary.takeaway: 提出Eigenius验证型科学知识基座的类型论与制度基础，将证明无关性改为被见证的命题公理，以保留并可比较同一主张的不同推导。
summary.methods: 设计带累积宇宙、非直谓Prop、索引强制单例消去与内涵恒等类型的依赖内核；统一宇宙累积、Π子类型与本体类包含的无强制包含判断；以三层制度层级组织外部验证器并内化辩护逻辑；在Lean 4中机器化元理论。
summary.relevance: 为知识图谱与检索增强系统提供可追溯推导与反事实撤回的形式化基础，契合知识表示与对齐主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出元理论证明与Lean 4机器化，未报告实际科学数据上的应用效果或可扩展性评估。

papers.title: RSI-PDEbench: A Benchmark for Self-Improving Agents in PDE Solving
papers.abstract: Identifying and solving partial differential equations (PDEs) from sampled solution data often requires substantial expert effort in equation discovery, coefficient estimation, and numerical solver configuration, especially under noise and distribution shifts. Can large language model (LLM) agents automate this workflow accurately and efficiently? To investigate this question, we introduce \bench{}, a benchmark of 1,001 cases spanning 42 equation templates, including both classical and fractional PDEs. It provides three evaluation settings: Full evaluates performance on noise-free solution data; Noisy tests robustness to Gaussian noise with an RMS equal to 50\% of the clean-signal RMS; and Hard-OOD tests challenging out-of-distribution generalization to unseen equation templates and shifted coefficient ranges. We further introduce RSI-PDE, a recursively self-improving agent harness that shortlists candidate equations by residual loss, uses relative $L^2$ feedback to refine coefficients and numerical solvers, and applies a validation gate to policy and memory updates. We compare RSI-PDE with single-run baselines and native agent harnesses (Claude Code or Codex) across four frontier models. Across the three settings, RSI-PDE improves the pass rate averaged across the four models by 106.5--181.9\% relative to single-run baselines and by 3.0--19.6\% relative to native harnesses, while reducing total recorded model calls by 46.9\% across the 12 model--setting pairs. These results highlight the potential of validated recursive self-improvement in LLM agents to advance scientific computing.

summary.takeaway: 提出RSI-PDEbench基准与递归自改进智能体RSI-PDE，用于评估LLM智能体从采样数据中识别与求解PDE的能力。
summary.methods: 基准含1,001个案例、42个方程模板，设Full、Noisy（Gaussian噪声RMS为干净信号50%）与Hard-OOD三种设定；智能体以残差损失筛选候选方程，用相对L2反馈修正系数与数值求解器，并设验证门控更新策略与记忆。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型智能体与检索增强式科学计算工作流评测。
summary.caveat: 结果为摘要自报的平均通过率提升与模型调用减少，未说明各模型单独表现及失败模式细分。

papers.title: Disentangled generative modeling of single-cell perturbation responses across dynamic cellular states
papers.abstract: Single-cell perturbation studies are increasingly conducted across complex, multi-condition biolog-ical systems, offering a powerful lens into how interventions reshape cell states and molecular pro-grams. However, standard computational models compress single-cell profiles into unified repre-sentations where treatment effects are obscured by cell division, lineage progression, donor varia-tion, and cellular stress. Here, we present Disentangled Variational Inference for Perturbation Re-sponse (PertVI), a deep generative model that separates baseline mitotic phase, cellular state, and batch effects from treatment-induced shifts while isolating aberrant off-manifold responses in or-thogonal anomaly space. This structured design tackles two intertwined tasks: (1) quantifying treatment-induced changes in cell-state composition, and (2) inferring state-gated transcriptional changes in response to treatment. Across simulated benchmarks, PertVI accurately disentangles coupled biological axes and recovers weak treatment signatures. In conditional chemical and genet-ic screens of primary human CD8+ and CD4+ T cells, PertVI separates memory-precursor adju-vants from toxic phenocopies, resolves co-clustered regulators into directional kinetic trajectories and biphasic rebounders obscured by standard workflows, and reveals that treatment-induced phe-notypic shifting is decoupled from broad transcriptional perturbation responses and instead gov-erned by state-specific impulses. Altogether, PertVI brings unique mechanistic granularity to sin-gle-cell perturbation response modeling, serving as a proof of principle for biology-informed, struc-ture-guided variance disentanglement in dynamic cellular systems.

summary.takeaway: 提出PertVI深度生成模型，将基线细胞状态、有丝分裂期与批次效应同处理诱导偏移解耦，并把异常响应隔离到正交空间。
summary.methods: 采用解耦变分推断，在模拟基准及原代人CD8+与CD4+ T细胞的化学与遗传筛选中评估，用于量化细胞状态组成变化与状态门控转录变化。
summary.relevance: 属于单细胞扰动响应建模，关注处理效应与动态细胞状态的分离。
summary.caveat: 摘要所述机制发现来自特定T细胞筛选，未给出跨组织或跨供体泛化的系统评估。

papers.title: CRISPR screens of noncanonical coding sequences and integrative multiomics uncover novel retrovirus-derived proteins
papers.abstract: Ribosome profiling has revealed thousands of noncanonical translation events across mammalian genomes, yet functional characterization has overwhelmingly focused on proliferative fitness in cancer cell lines. Here, we present a comprehensive survey of noncanonical translation in the mouse immune system and its functional consequences in macrophages. By performing a meta-analysis of Ribo-seq across 20 public mouse leukocyte and 5 human leukocyte datasets we define a compendium of 22,572 mouse and 18,701 human noncanonical coding sequences (nCDSs), including upstream ORFs (uORFs), downstream ORFs, and ORFs on noncoding RNAs and pseudogenes (ncORFs). Cross species conservation and proteogenomic integration with reanalyzed mass spectrometry data prioritizes a high-confidence subset. To move beyond cataloging, we carried out two orthogonal CRISPR screens in immortalized bone marrow-derived macrophages: a fitness screen identifying nCDSs required for macrophage viability, and a TLR1/TLR2-NF{kappa}B reporter screen uncovering nCDSs that modulate innate immune signaling. These screens suggested dozens of nCDSs for functional follow up including a family of endogenous retroviral envelope-derived proteins translated in adult mouse myeloid cells. Updated single-cell RNA-seq annotations and an interactive UCSC Genome Browser session integrating Ribo-seq, proteomics, and CRISPR screen data are provided as community resources. Together, these findings expand the functional landscape of noncanonical translation in immunity and nominate endogenous retroviral proteins as previously unrecognized regulators of murine macrophage biology.

summary.takeaway: 系统调查小鼠免疫系统中的非规范翻译，并通过CRISPR筛选提名包括内源逆转录病毒包膜衍生蛋白在内的候选功能nCDS。
summary.methods: 整合20个小鼠与5个人类白细胞Ribo-seq数据集，结合跨物种保守性与质谱再分析优先化高置信nCDS；在永生化骨髓来源巨噬细胞中开展适应性筛选与TLR1/TLR2-NFκB报告筛选，并提供单细胞RNA-seq注释与UCSC浏览器资源。
summary.relevance: 与单细胞扰动主题相关，利用筛选扰动推断非规范编码序列在免疫细胞中的功能。
summary.caveat: 功能验证主要在永生化巨噬细胞中进行，体内生理相关性尚未在摘要中体现。

papers.title: HV-MultiScaleGNN: A Multi-Scale Graph Neural Network Framework for Host-Virus Protein-Protein Interactions Prediction
papers.abstract: Accurate identification of HV-PPIs is essential for understanding viral infection mechanisms and for developing antiviral therapeutic discovery. However, the experimental identification process is often time-consuming and expensive, while many computational approaches depend on incomplete protein sequences, structural and interaction information. Here, we present HV-MultiScaleGNN, a topology-driven multi-scale GNN framework for HV-PPIs prediction that operates exclusively on the topology of a heterogeneous interaction network. The framework formulates HV-PPIs prediction as a heterogeneous link prediction problem by integrating the human interactome with experimentally validated HV-PPIs. HV-MultiScaleGNN systematically investigates three complementary graph representation strategies, viz. Local view, Global view and an integrated Local+Global view. The Local view employs one-hop relation-aware graph attention to model fine-grained neighbourhood interactions. The Global view captures higher-order structural dependencies through propagation-based neighbourhood aggregation. The integrated representation combines both views to jointly encode local connectivity and global topological context within a unified embedding space, enabling relation-specific link prediction without relying on sequence- or structure-derived features. Experiments on large-scale HV-PPIs datasets evaluate all three strategies using discrimination, calibration, and ranking metrics. The Local view achieved the best discriminative performance (AUROC = 0.9444, AUPRC = 0.9422), whereas the Global view exhibited the lowest ECE (0.0379). The integrated Local+Global view provided consistently strong predictive performance (AUROC = 0.9378, AUPRC = 0.9356). Comparative evaluation against representative graph representation learning methods showed competitive predictive performance. Furthermore, interfacial interactions were identified using protein-protein docking and atomistic-level understanding was explored. Moreover, GO and KEGG enrichment provided additional functional insights into the selected host proteins. The proposed framework enables systematic evaluation of complementary graph representation strategies for heterogeneous biological link prediction and helps experimental researchers to delineate novel HV-PPIs.

summary.takeaway: 提出仅依赖异质互作网络拓扑的HV-MultiScaleGNN框架，将宿主-病毒蛋白互作预测建模为异质链接预测。
summary.methods: 比较局部一阶关系感知图注意力、全局传播聚合及二者融合三种表示；在大规模HV-PPIs数据集上用判别、校准与排序指标评估，并辅以对接、GO与KEGG富集分析。
summary.relevance: 涉及图谱构建与表示学习，展示多尺度图表示在生物互作网络上的应用。
summary.caveat: 结果为单一数据集上的自报指标，未与湿实验验证闭环，且不依赖序列或结构特征可能限制对新病毒的泛化。

papers.title: Causals: An Open Knowledge Graph for Research on Causal Reasoning
papers.abstract: Applying causal knowledge to a new event requires connecting the event to relevant entities and the relationships through which its consequences may unfold. We present Causals, an open knowledge graph for research on this form of reasoning. Its initial release, constructed from news reports, contains 369,184 nodes and 1,272,418 edges linking reported events, organizations, commodities, financial instruments, and other entities. Structural relationships, observations, and attributed causal claims retain distinct semantics and links to source records. We describe the construction and representation of the resource and characterize its connectivity and multi-hop retrieval properties. Causals provides shared relational knowledge for studying how language models retrieve relevant context and apply mechanisms to particular events. The dataset is available under CC BY 4.0 at https://causals.org/, and we invite contributions to its ontology, records, and evidence.

summary.takeaway: 发布Causals开放知识图谱，用于研究将因果知识连接到具体事件并检索相关上下文。
summary.methods: 从新闻报道构建，初始版本含369,184个节点与1,272,418条边，区分结构关系、观测与归因因果主张并保留来源记录；描述其连通性与多跳检索特性。
summary.relevance: 直接服务于知识图谱与语言模型因果推理的检索上下文研究。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告基于该图谱的模型实验效果，数据源自新闻可能引入报道偏差。

papers.title: Negative-Only Policy Optimization for One-Sided Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically relies on a verifier that can reliably judge whether sampled solutions are correct. However, in many realistic settings, complete verification is generally unavailable, while cheap checks can only falsify failures. We formalize this regime as one-sided verifiability (OSV): verified negatives are reliable counterexamples, but verified positives are merely non-falsified candidates and may contain many false positives. This asymmetry makes standard RLVR unreliable, because reinforcing verified positives can directly reward shortcuts that pass partial checks. To address this issue, we propose Negative-Only Policy Optimization (NOPO), which treats verified positives as unlabeled and updates the policy only by suppressing trusted verified negatives. Specifically, NOPO combines a reference-relative negative suppression loss with a group-level adapter that scales each update by the proportion of non-falsified responses. Across unit-test, constraint-check, and LLM self-verifiers, NOPO improves pass@k over baselines on code, logic, and math benchmarks when oracle rewards are unavailable. These gains persist under inference-time scaling and cross-benchmark transfer.

summary.takeaway: 针对单侧可验证奖励场景提出NOPO，将已验证正例视为未标注，仅通过抑制可信负例更新策略。
summary.methods: 结合参考相对的负例抑制损失与组级适配器，按非被证伪响应比例缩放更新；在单元测试、约束检查与LLM自验证器下评估代码、逻辑与数学基准。
summary.relevance: 属于强化学习与可验证奖励方向，讨论验证不完整时的奖励错配问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体提升数值，且假设负例验证可靠，该假设在复杂任务中可能不成立。

papers.title: KuaiRecV2: Benchmarking Large-Scale Continual Learning for Diversified and Multi-task Recommendation
papers.abstract: Recommender systems, which retrieve items of interest to users based on their interaction histories, have recently witnessed several key technological advancements, benefiting from the semantic representation space and model-data scaling. Nevertheless, practitioners and researchers have frequently encountered critical inconsistencies between simple offline evaluations and complex online results, and this gap still exists in the era of large models. In this work, we address several key factors that contribute to this inconsistency: 1) the \textit{large-scale continual learning challenge} that assumes a practical demand to maintain long-term model effectiveness under dynamic item pools and distributional shifts; 2) the \textit{combinatorial diversity challenge} that requires the generation strategy to solve the accuracy-diversity trade-off in both the finer token level and the holistic item level; and 3) the \textit{multi-task reward balancing challenge}, which is particularly critical for modern generative models that can accurately model the sequence distribution but are less controllable for the multi-task demands. To address these challenges and further pave the way for the development of more realistic recommendation solutions, we introduce KuaiRecV2, a deliberately constructed benchmark with industrial-level datasets from Kuaishou. Specifically, we provide a large-scale interaction dataset with million-scale multi-modal item information and long-term interaction records across 30 days, with a dynamic video candidate pool. Additionally, we provide a rigorous benchmark that evaluates retrieval accuracy, diversity, and multi-task performance in one rubric system, where an effective advancement occurs if and only if the new method improves all metrics. The code is available at https://github.com/cxli2333/KuaiRecV2

summary.takeaway: 发布KuaiRecV2基准，针对推荐系统大规模持续学习、组合多样性与多任务奖励平衡三方面挑战进行统一评测。
summary.methods: 基于快手工业级数据，提供百万级多模态物品信息与30天长期交互记录及动态视频候选池；在统一评分体系中同时评估检索准确率、多样性与多任务表现，要求新方法在所有指标上均改进。
summary.relevance: 直接对应持续学习主题，关注动态物品池与分布漂移下的模型长期有效性。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供基线结果数值，基准来自单一平台，跨平台可迁移性未知。

papers.title: Improved Elastic Weight Consolidation as an Optimization Constraint for Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) is a widely used regularization-based technique for continual learning, protecting performance on old tasks with a quadratic penalty whose empirical Fisher is usually justified through probabilistic curvature. We instead introduce Continual Learning as an Optimization Constraint (CLOC): new training must preserve chosen functionals of learned behavior. EWC's empirical Fisher is exactly the first-order form of this constraint when the preserved functional is each sample's loss. This derivation exposes a flaw: EWC implicitly weights each sample by the scale of its loss gradient, so well-fitted samples lose importance. EWC-DR observed this failure in classification; CLOC identifies its general cause. Improved Elastic Weight Consolidation (IEWC) penalizes output changes according to the first-order approximation of each old sample's loss level set, removing the weighting for any differentiable loss and output geometry, and prevents corrupt samples from dominating the importance matrix. Across classification, segmentation, language, forecasting, and diffusion, IEWC variants match or improve on EWC and outperform EWC-DR. In a held-out evaluation with validation-selected hyperparameters, uniform IEWC improves ImageNet-R accuracy over matched EWC by 2.00 percentage points (95% CI 0.93-3.07).

summary.takeaway: 提出将持续学习视为优化约束的框架CLOC，据此指出EWC按样本损失梯度尺度加权的缺陷，并给出改进方法IEWC，使旧样本损失水平集的一阶近似决定惩罚。
summary.methods: 从优化约束视角重新推导EWC的经验Fisher；在分类、分割、语言、预测和扩散任务上评估IEWC变体，并与EWC和EWC-DR比较；另做验证集选超参的留出评估，报告ImageNet-R准确率差异及95%置信区间。
summary.relevance: 该文直接研究持续学习中的正则化方法，改进EWC以缓解旧任务遗忘，与给定主题“持续学习”高度相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出各任务的具体数据集、模型规模和计算开销；ImageNet-R的提升仅针对uniform IEWC与匹配EWC的留出评估，其他任务仅称匹配或提升，未列具体数值。
